QUOTE.unsure: I'm not sure about this one, double-check me.
QUOTE.curious: Interesting, I want to know more.
QUOTE.concerned: Careful, this might be sensitive or risky.
QUOTE.listening: Ask me something in Chat and I'll show you how I feel about it.

INTRO.TITLE: An AI that lives on your phone.
INTRO.TEXT: Canis answers your questions and shows you how sure it is. It works offline, and nothing leaves your device.

DOG.TITLE: Meet Canis.
DOG.TEXT: While it answers, Canis shows how it stands on what it's saying. Watch the colour and the label, just like you'd read a face. Tap the dog to see its states.

MODEL.TITLE: Choose a model
MODEL.TEXT: This is what Canis thinks with. It downloads once, then works without internet.
MODEL.WIFI: Best on Wi-Fi. You can change this later in Settings.
MODEL.BACKGROUND: The download keeps going in the background.

EMPTY.TITLE: Hi, I'm Canis.
EMPTY.TEXT: Ask me anything. I'll show you how sure I am while I answer.

WAITING.TITLE: Almost ready.
WAITING.TEXT: I'm still downloading. Pick a question now and I'll answer as soon as I'm done.

NO_MODEL.TITLE: I need a model to think with.
NO_MODEL.TEXT: Download one in Settings. It takes a few minutes on Wi-Fi, then I work offline.

SUGGESTION.BIRTHDAY: Help me write a birthday note for my sister
SUGGESTION.DOUGH: Is it safe to eat raw cookie dough?

CHAT.QUEUED: I'll answer as soon as the download is done.
CHAT.ERROR_TITLE: Something went wrong on my side.

ERROR.modelNotDownloaded: The model isn't downloaded yet. Your question is still here.
ERROR.outOfMemory: Your question is still here. Closing other apps can give me more room to think.
ERROR.thermal: Your phone is too warm right now. Let it cool down for a moment, then try again.
ERROR.background: I can only think while the app is open. Your question is still here.
ERROR.unknown: Your question is still here. Please try again.

CORRECTION.TITLE: What was it really?
CORRECTION.SHARE_OFF: Off: your feedback stays on this phone.
CORRECTION.SHARE_ON: On: this answer and your note are shared to improve Canis.

HOW.TEXT: While Canis writes, it reads signals inside the model: how spread out its next-word choices are, and which ideas it keeps leaning toward. Together they set the dog's state. It shows the model's stance on its answer, not feelings.

CANIS.WELCOME_BACK: Welcome back. Pick up where we left off, or ask me something new.
CANIS.FIRST_QUOTE: Hi, I'm Canis. Ask me something and I'll show you how sure I am, right here.

DESCRIPTION.canis-apertus: Swiss open model. Clear, careful answers in many languages.

MODELS.NO_SPACE: Not enough space. This model needs about {{size}} free.
MODELS.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download couldn't start. Please try again.
MODELS.DELETE_TEXT: You can download it again later.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.SHOW_DETAILS: Show details on the Canis tab
SETTINGS.HAPTICS: Haptics when the dog changes state
SETTINGS.PRIVACY_TEXT: Nothing leaves your device. No account, no cloud.
SETTINGS.DELETE_HISTORY_TEXT: This removes {{count}} conversations and the dog's readouts for them from this phone. It can't be undone.

KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge packs
KNOWLEDGE.INTRO: Canis can answer from your own documents and shows where an answer came from. Everything stays on this phone.
KNOWLEDGE.FORMATS: PDF, text or Markdown files. You can also open a file with Canis from another app.
KNOWLEDGE.IMPORT_DONE_TEXT: Generate titles from its menu to improve search over time.
KNOWLEDGE.NAME: Name
KNOWLEDGE.DELETE_TEXT: The pack is removed from this phone.

HISTORY.TITLE: History
HISTORY.EMPTY_TEXT: When you chat with me, I keep the conversation here so you can come back to it. It stays on this phone.
